name: hedera-safe-swap
description: Gnosis Safe multisig treasury on Hedera: a 2-of-3 owner-quorum module rebalances idle holdings through SaucerSwap, a permissionless price-guarded module backed by live Chainlink/Supra oracles, and rebalance proposals relayed between owners via HCS.

instructions: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in your Hedera testnet operator credentials.
Deploy contracts: npx hardhat run packages/contracts/scripts/deploy.ts --network hedera-testnet
See README.md for the full setup and architecture.
